english_evidence: Aggregator autorijschooltarieven.nl lists the school's instruction language explicitly as 'Taal: Nederlands' (Dutch); no English-language signal appears on any aggregator, and the school's own site/reviews are Dutch-only.
notes: Small one-man eenmanszaak (1 employee), owner Gerrie Hanegraaf ('Gerrie' in reviews). KvK 16047203 registered 21-02-1984, consistent with clickdrive/educar '42 jaar ervaring'; rijloket's 'meer dan 55 jaar' claim is an unreliable outlier. Category B only per clickdrive/educar (some aggregators list A/AM as boilerplate). CBR exam location: Den Bosch. Notably low pass rate (~38% across aggregators; rijloket shows 6.7% on a low exam count). Lesauto is an Audi A4 but no explicit automaat/schakel statement found, so transmission left unknown. Google/aggregator ratings conflict: clickdrive & educar show 5.0 (2 reviews) while rijloket's comparison table shows 3.0/5 with one strongly negative Google review; rated google_rating=3.0 (rijloket, lower bound) with review_count=2 from clickdrive/educar.
